title: Akademik lug‘at: eng muhim 300 so‘z
goal_uz: Dars oxirida akademik so‘zlarni oilasi, to‘g‘ri hamrohlari va rasmiy sinonimlari bilan ajrata olasiz hamda kamida 15 ta akademik so‘z qatnashgan paragraf yozasiz.

scenes.title: Akademik lug‘atga xush kelibsiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Yangi darsga xush kelibsiz. Oldingi darsda inversiya va ta’kidlovchi tuzilmalarni o‘rgandik: “Never had I seen…”, “What I need is…”. Endi gapning shaklidan so‘zning o‘ziga o‘tamiz. Bugun akademik lug‘atning asosiy qatlamini ochamiz. Dars oxirida so‘zlarni oilalari bilan, hamroh so‘zlari bilan va rasmiy sinonimlari bilan ishlata olasiz hamda akademik paragraf yozasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back. Last time we looked at inversion and emphatic structures. Today we turn from sentence shape to the words themselves: the academic vocabulary that makes writing precise.
scenes.say_uz: Xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan safar inversiya va ta’kidlovchi tuzilmalarni ko‘rdik. Bugun gap shaklidan so‘zlarning o‘ziga o‘tamiz: yozuvni aniq qiladigan akademik lug‘atga.

scenes.title: Nega akademik lug‘at?
scenes.say_native: Akademik matnlarda ma’lum so‘zlar qayta-qayta uchraydi. Yangi Zelandiyalik tilshunos Averil Koksxed shunday so‘zlarning ro‘yxatini tuzgan va u Academic Word List deb ataladi. Unda taxminan besh yuz yetmish so‘z oilasi bor va ular akademik matn so‘zlarining taxminan o‘ndan birini tashkil qiladi. Bu juda katta ulush. Maqsadimiz uch yuz muhim so‘zni tizimli o‘zlashtirish. Bugun tizimning o‘zini o‘rganamiz, so‘zlarni esa namunalarda ko‘rasiz.
scenes.say: Certain words appear again and again in academic texts. The Academic Word List, compiled by Averil Coxhead, gathers about five hundred and seventy word families, and they make up roughly one tenth of the words in academic writing.
scenes.say_uz: Akademik matnlarda ayrim so‘zlar tinmay uchraydi. Averil Koksxed tuzgan Academic Word List taxminan 570 so‘z oilasini o‘z ichiga oladi va ular akademik yozuvdagi so‘zlarning taxminan o‘ndan birini tashkil qiladi.

scenes.title: Sizning ustunligingiz

examples.t: The structure of the argument is clear.

scenes.say_native: Sizda katta ustunlik bor: o‘zbek tilida akademik so‘zlar juda ko‘p, ularning ko‘pi rus yoki yunon-lotin ildizli. Analysis bu tahlil yoki analiz, factor bu omil yoki faktor, structure bu struktura, function bu funksiya, sector bu sektor, method bu metod. Ma’nosi ko‘pincha mos keladi. Lekin imlo, talaffuz va urg‘u boshqacha, ayniqsa urg‘u. Ayrim so‘zlar aldamchi, bu haqida keyinroq gaplashamiz.
scenes.say: The structure of the argument is clear. Many English academic words will already feel familiar to you, but spelling and stress often differ.
scenes.say_uz: Dalilning tuzilishi aniq. Ko‘p inglizcha akademik so‘zlar sizga tanish tuyuladi, lekin imlo va urg‘u ko‘pincha boshqacha.

scenes.title: Birinchi nuqta: so‘z oilalari
board: Word family = bir ildiz, bir nechta so‘z turkumi

examples.t: She created a new model.
Her creativity impressed the committee.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi nuqta: so‘z oilalari. Bitta so‘zni yodlash o‘rniga butun oilani o‘rganing. Create fe’l, creation ot, creative sifat, creatively ravish, creativity yana ot. Ildiz bir, ammo gapda o‘rni boshqa. Akademik yozuvda aynan shu muhim: bir fikrni fe’l bilan emas, ot bilan ifodalash kerak bo‘lishi mumkin. Oilani bilsangiz, gap tuzilishiga qarab to‘g‘ri shaklni tanlay olasiz.
scenes.say: She created a new model. Her creativity impressed the committee. One root, many forms: create, creation, creative, creatively, creativity.
scenes.say_uz: U yangi model yaratdi. Uning ijodkorligi komissiyani hayratga soldi. Bir ildiz, ko‘p shakl.

scenes.title: Oila: analyse

examples.t: We need to analyse the data.
The analysis revealed a clear pattern.
She takes an analytical approach.

scenes.say_native: Keling, bitta oilani to‘liq ko‘raylik. Analyse fe’l: tahlil qilmoq. Analysis ot: tahlil. Ko‘plik shakli analyses, oxirgi bo‘g‘in “siz” deb o‘qiladi. Analyst bu tahlilchi, analytical sifat, analytically ravish. Britaniya imlosida analyse, amerikaliklarda analyze. Diqqat qiling: “analysis the data” deyish xato, chunki analysis ot, fe’l emas.
scenes.say: We need to analyse the data. The analysis revealed a clear pattern. She takes an analytical approach, and her analyst colleagues agree.
scenes.say_uz: Ma’lumotlarni tahlil qilishimiz kerak. Tahlil aniq qonuniyatni ko‘rsatdi. U tahliliy yondashuvni tanlaydi, tahlilchi hamkasblari ham rozi.

scenes.title: Qo‘shimchalar yo‘l ko‘rsatadi
scenes.say_native: Qo‘shimchalar so‘z turkumini oshkor qiladi. Tion, ment, ity, ance bilan tugasa, odatda ot: decision, development, reality, importance. Ise yoki ize, ify, en bilan tugasa fe’l: emphasise, clarify, widen. Al, ive, ous, ic, ent bilan tugasa sifat: national, effective, various, economic, significant. Ly odatda ravish. Albatta istisnolar bor, masalan friendly sifat, lekin bu qoida taxminiy yo‘l ko‘rsatkichi sifatida juda foydali.
scenes.say: Suffixes signal the part of speech. Tion, ment and ity make nouns; ise and ify make verbs; al, ive and ous make adjectives; ly usually makes adverbs. There are exceptions, such as friendly.
scenes.say_uz: Qo‘shimchalar so‘z turkumini bildiradi. Tion, ment, ity ot yasaydi; ise, ify fe’l; al, ive, ous sifat; ly odatda ravish. Friendly kabi istisnolar bor.

scenes.title: Oila: economy

examples.t: Economic growth slowed last year.
A small car is more economical.

scenes.say_native: Bu oilada tuzoq bor. Economic bu iqtisodga oid: economic growth, economic policy. Economical esa tejamkor degani: an economical car. Ikkalasi o‘zaro almashmaydi. Economics bu fan yoki soha, ko‘pligi shakliga qaramay birlik sifatida ishlatiladi: economics is difficult. Economy esa mamlakat iqtisodiyotining o‘zi, economist iqtisodchi. O‘zbekchada hammasi “iqtisod” ildizidan, inglizcha esa har biri alohida.
scenes.say: Economic growth slowed last year. A small car is more economical. Economics is a fascinating subject, and an economist studies the economy.
scenes.say_uz: O‘tgan yili iqtisodiy o‘sish sekinlashdi. Kichik mashina tejamkorroq. Iqtisodiyot fani qiziqarli, iqtisodchi esa iqtisodiyotni o‘rganadi.

scenes.title: Oila: significant

examples.t: The results are statistically significant.
Prices rose significantly.

scenes.say_native: Significant akademik matnlarda eng ko‘p uchraydigan sifatlardan biri. U ikki ma’noda ishlatiladi: katta, sezilarli, va muhim, ahamiyatli. Significantly ravish: sezilarli darajada. Significance bu ahamiyat, signify fe’l: bildirmoq. Insignificant esa ahamiyatsiz. Statistikada “statistically significant” alohida atama: natija tasodifan yuz bermagan. Urg‘u: sigNIFicant, lekin SIGnify.
scenes.say: The results are statistically significant. Prices rose significantly. The significance of this finding should not be underestimated.
scenes.say_uz: Natijalar statistik jihatdan ahamiyatli. Narxlar sezilarli oshdi. Bu topilmaning ahamiyatini kam baholamaslik kerak.

scenes.title: Noto‘g‘ri so‘z turkumi
scenes.say_native: Eng keng tarqalgan xato: so‘z to‘g‘ri, turkumi noto‘g‘ri. Ot oldidan sifat kerak, ot emas. “The economy growth” emas, “economic growth”. O‘zbekchada “iqtisod o‘sishi” deymiz va ot yonma-yon turadi, shuning uchun siz ham shunday tuzasiz. Ikkinchisi: “is very significance”, bu yerda sifat kerak, “significant”. Yana “analysis the data” va “he did an important contribute” kabi xatolarga ehtiyot bo‘ling, to‘g‘risi “analyse” va “contribution”.
scenes.say: Economic growth, not economy growth. It is highly significant, not significance. We analyse data, and we make a contribution.
scenes.say_uz: Economic growth, economy growth emas. Highly significant, significance emas. Biz ma’lumotni tahlil qilamiz va hissa qo‘shamiz.

scenes.title: Salbiy prefikslar

examples.t: The data were inconsistent.
Critics misinterpreted the results.

scenes.say_native: Oila ichida prefikslar ham bor. In bilan inkor yasaladi: consistent, inconsistent. Un bilan: reliable, unreliable. Mis bilan noto‘g‘ri bajarilgan harakat: interpret, misinterpret. Dis bilan qarama-qarshi harakat: prove, disprove. Muhim qoida: in prefiksi l, m, p, r oldida o‘zgaradi: illegal, impossible, irregular.
scenes.say: The data were inconsistent. Critics misinterpreted the results. A prefix like in, un, mis or dis can double your vocabulary: consistent, inconsistent; prove, disprove.
scenes.say_uz: Ma’lumotlar nomuvofiq edi. Tanqidchilar natijalarni noto‘g‘ri talqin qilishdi. Prefiks lug‘atingizni ikki baravar oshirishi mumkin.

scenes.title: To‘g‘ri shaklni tanlang
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gap. Har birida qavs ichidan to‘g‘ri shaklni tanlang. Yo‘l-yo‘riq: ot oldidan sifat turadi, modal fe’ldan keyin fe’l keladi, “is” dan keyin sifat bo‘ladi, “her” dan keyin ot turadi. Javobingizni baland ovozda, to‘liq gap bilan ayting. Bu ham gapirish mashqi.
scenes.say: One: the economy or economic growth slowed? Two: we must analyse or analysis the data? Three: the difference is significant or significance? Four: her interpret or interpretation was unusual?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: economy yoki economic growth? Ikki: analyse yoki analysis? Uch: significant yoki significance? To‘rt: interpret yoki interpretation?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: economic growth, chunki ot oldida sifat turadi. Ikki: analyse, modal fe’l “must” dan keyin fe’l keladi. Uch: significant, “is” dan keyin sifat. To‘rt: her interpretation, egalik olmoshidan keyin ot turadi. Qiynalsangiz, avval gapda so‘z qaysi vazifada turganini aniqlang.
scenes.say: One, economic growth. Two, analyse. Three, significant. Four, her interpretation. First decide the job of the word in the sentence, then choose the form.
scenes.say_uz: Bir, economic growth. Ikki, analyse. Uch, significant. To‘rt, her interpretation. Avval so‘zning gapdagi vazifasini aniqlang, keyin shaklni tanlang.

scenes.title: Urg‘u oila ichida siljiydi
scenes.say_native: Talaffuzda juda muhim qonuniyat bor: oila ichida urg‘u siljiydi va unli tovushlar ham o‘zgaradi. ANalyse da urg‘u boshida, aNAlysis da ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda, anaLYTical da uchinchida. Urg‘u tushmagan unlilar kuchsiz, schwa ga aylanadi. Shu sababli bitta harf turli o‘qiladi. Yana ot va fe’l o‘rtasida farq: ot bo‘lsa urg‘u boshida, INcrease, fe’l bo‘lsa oxirida, inCREASE. Contrast, conduct, record ham shunday.
scenes.say: Stress moves inside a word family: analyse, analysis, analytical. And many two-syllable words stress the noun at the start and the verb at the end: an increase, to increase.
scenes.say_uz: Urg‘u oila ichida siljiydi: analyse, analysis, analytical. Ko‘p ikki bo‘g‘inli so‘zlarda ot boshida, fe’l oxirida urg‘ulanadi.

scenes.title: Urg‘uni takrorlang
scenes.say_native: Endi takrorlang. Avval analyse, analysis, analytical. Urg‘uli bo‘g‘inni balandroq va cho‘zibroq ayting, qolgan bo‘g‘inlarni qisqa va yengil. Keyin economy va economic. Oxirida contrast va increase so‘zlarini avval ot, keyin fe’l sifatida ayting. Shoshilmang, aniqlik tezlikdan muhimroq.
scenes.say: Analyse. Analysis. Analytical. Economy. Economic. A contrast. To contrast. An increase. To increase.
scenes.say_uz: Analyse. Analysis. Analytical. Economy. Economic. Qarama-qarshilik. Qarama-qarshi qo‘ymoq. O‘sish. O‘smoq.

scenes.title: Urg‘u javobi
scenes.say_native: Tekshirib ko‘ramiz. Analysis da urg‘u “NA” bo‘g‘inida, analytical da “LYT” bo‘g‘inida. Economy da “CO”, economic da “NOM”. Ot bo‘lsa contrast va increase boshidan urg‘ulanadi, fe’l bo‘lsa oxiridan. Noto‘g‘ri urg‘u bilan aytilgan so‘z tinglovchiga tushunarsiz bo‘lib qoladi.
scenes.say: Analysis, stress on na. Analytical, stress on lyt. Economy, co. Economic, nom. Nouns like contrast and increase: front stress. Verbs: end stress.
scenes.say_uz: Analysis, na da. Analytical, lyt da. Economy, co da. Economic, nom da. Otlar boshida, fe’llar oxirida urg‘ulanadi.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi nuqta: kollokatsiyalar
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi nuqta: kollokatsiyalar, ya’ni so‘zlarning doimiy hamrohligi. O‘zbekchada “tadqiqot o‘tkazmoq” deymiz, inglizchada research bilan conduct yoki carry out ishlatiladi, make emas. Mantiq yo‘q, shunchaki odat. Ona tilidagi so‘zma-so‘z tarjima aynan shu yerda xato beradi. Akademik yozuvda to‘g‘ri hamrohlik o‘quvchida ishonch uyg‘otadi. Shuning uchun so‘zni yakka emas, hamrohi bilan yodlang.
scenes.say: Words keep company. We conduct research; we do not make research. A native reader hears the right partner at once, and a wrong partner stands out immediately.
scenes.say_uz: So‘zlar o‘z hamrohi bilan keladi. Research bilan conduct deymiz, make emas. O‘quvchi to‘g‘ri hamrohni darrov sezadi, noto‘g‘risi esa ko‘zga tashlanadi.

scenes.title: Fe’l + ot

examples.t: They conducted a large-scale survey.
We cannot draw firm conclusions yet.
The policy fails to address the problem.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi guruh: fe’l va ot. Conduct a survey, carry out an experiment. Draw a conclusion, ya’ni xulosa chiqarmoq: draw, boshqa fe’l emas. Pose a threat yoki pose a question: xavf tug‘dirmoq, savol qo‘ymoq. Address an issue: masalani hal qilishga kirishmoq. Reach a consensus: kelishuvga erishmoq. Yana raise concerns, play a role, impose restrictions, undergo change.
scenes.say: They conducted a large-scale survey. We cannot draw firm conclusions yet. The policy fails to address the problem. Experts reached a consensus.
scenes.say_uz: Ular keng ko‘lamli so‘rovnoma o‘tkazishdi. Hozircha qat’iy xulosa chiqara olmaymiz. Siyosat muammoni hal qila olmaydi. Mutaxassislar kelishuvga erishdi.

scenes.title: Sifat + ot

examples.t: The reform had a profound impact on schools.
There is empirical evidence for this claim.
examples.uz: Bu da’voni tasdiqlovchi empirik dalil bor.

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi guruh: sifat va ot. Significant impact, ya’ni sezilarli ta’sir. Substantial increase, katta o‘sish: bu yerda “big” juda oddiy eshitiladi. Rigorous analysis, puxta tahlil. Empirical evidence, tajribaga asoslangan dalil. Widespread criticism, keng tarqalgan tanqid. Evidence sanalmaydigan ot, shuning uchun “an evidence” yoki “evidences” demaymiz. Research ham xuddi shunday.
scenes.say: The reform had a profound impact on schools. There is empirical evidence for this claim. Evidence and research are uncountable nouns.
scenes.say_uz: Islohot maktablarga chuqur ta’sir qildi. Bu da’voni empirik dalil tasdiqlaydi. Evidence va research sanalmaydigan otlar.

scenes.title: Ravish va tayyor qoliplar
board: a wide range of · a considerable number of

examples.t: It is highly unlikely that the effect is random.
examples.uz: Ta’sir tasodifiy bo‘lishi ehtimoldan juda yiroq.

scenes.say_native: Uchinchi guruh: ravish va sifat. Highly unlikely, widely accepted, deeply rooted, strongly argue. Tayyor qoliplar ham juda foydali: “a growing body of evidence”, ya’ni tobora ko‘payib borayotgan dalillar, “a wide range of” va “a considerable number of”. Ravishni almashtirib bo‘lmaydi: “highly accepted” yoki “strongly unlikely” deyilmaydi. Shuning uchun butun qolipni yodlash xavfsizroq.
scenes.say: It is highly unlikely that the effect is random. A growing body of evidence supports this view. A wide range of factors is involved.
scenes.say_uz: Ta’sir tasodifiy bo‘lishi ehtimoldan juda yiroq. Tobora ko‘payayotgan dalillar bu qarashni qo‘llab-quvvatlaydi. Keng doiradagi omillar ishtirok etadi.

scenes.title: Kollokatsiya xatolari
board: ✗ do a conclusion · ✓ draw a conclusion
✗ a lot of evidences · ✓ a great deal of evidence
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta xato. Make research emas, conduct research. Do a conclusion emas, draw a conclusion. “A lot of evidences” emas, evidence sanalmaydigan ot, shuning uchun “a great deal of evidence”. Highly accepted emas, widely accepted. Bu xatolar grammatika qoidasini buzmaydi, lekin matn sun’iy eshitiladi. Yozganingizni tekshirishda har bir fe’l va ot juftligidan so‘rang: ingliz o‘quvchisi shu juftlikni uchratganmi?
scenes.say: We conduct research. We draw conclusions. We have a great deal of evidence. The theory is widely accepted. These pairs sound natural.
scenes.say_uz: Biz tadqiqot o‘tkazamiz. Xulosa chiqaramiz. Bizda ko‘p dalil bor. Nazariya keng qabul qilingan.

scenes.title: Mos fe’lni toping
scenes.say_native: Beshta ibora. Beshta fe’ldan har bir joyga bittasini tanlang: address, impose, yield, pose, gain. Har bir fe’l faqat bir marta ishlatiladi. Savollarni tinglang va to‘liq ibora bilan javob bering, masalan “address an issue”. Birinchi fikringiz odatda to‘g‘ri bo‘ladi, shuning uchun uzoq o‘ylamang.
scenes.say: One: blank an issue. Two: blank restrictions. Three: blank results. Four: blank a threat. Five: blank insight into.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: masalani … Ikki: cheklovlarni … Uch: natijalarni … To‘rt: xavfni … Besh: tushunchani …

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Address an issue, masalani hal qilishga kirishmoq. Impose restrictions, cheklov joriy etmoq. Yield results, natija bermoq: yield tajribalar va ekinlar haqida ham ishlatiladi. Pose a threat, xavf tug‘dirmoq. Gain insight into, biror narsani chuqurroq tushunib yetmoq. Ularni bir necha marta ayting.
scenes.say: Address an issue. Impose restrictions. Yield results. Pose a threat. Gain insight into a subject. Say each phrase aloud until it feels natural.
scenes.say_uz: Masalani hal qilmoq. Cheklov joriy etmoq. Natija bermoq. Xavf tug‘dirmoq. Mavzuni chuqurroq tushunmoq.

scenes.title: Tinglash: seminar suhbati
board: A: Did you finish the article on urban policy?
B: Yes. The author identifies housing costs as a major factor.
A: Her evidence draws on data from forty cities.
B: Only the largest, and she ignores the rural sector.
scenes.say_native: Endi real suhbatni tinglang. Ikki talaba seminar uchun o‘qilgan maqolani muhokama qilmoqda. Ularning gapida akademik so‘zlar tabiiy ishlatilgan: identify, major factor, data, sector, valid. Diqqat bilan tinglang, keyin uchta savolga javob berasiz. Birinchi marta tushunmagan joyingiz bo‘lsa xavotir olmang, kalit so‘zlarga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Did you finish the article on urban policy? Yes. The author identifies housing costs as a major factor, but I think her evidence is limited. She draws on data from forty cities. True, but only the largest, and she ignores the rural sector. So the conclusion may not be valid everywhere. Exactly.
scenes.say_uz: Shahar siyosati haqidagi maqolani o‘qib bo‘ldingizmi? Ha. Muallif uy-joy narxini asosiy omil deb ko‘rsatadi, lekin dalillari cheklangan. U qirqta shahar ma’lumotidan foydalanadi. To‘g‘ri, faqat eng kattalari, qishloq sektorini esa e’tiborsiz qoldiradi. Demak xulosa hamma joyda to‘g‘ri bo‘lmasligi mumkin. Aynan.

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
board: 2) How many cities are in the data?
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: muallif qaysi omilni asosiy deb hisoblaydi? Ikkinchi: ma’lumot nechta shahardan olingan? Uchinchi: muallif nimani e’tiborsiz qoldiradi? Suhbatni eslab, har biriga o‘zingizcha to‘liq gap bilan javob bering. Masalan: “The author identifies … as a major factor.”
scenes.say: One: what is the major factor? Two: how many cities are in the data? Three: what does the author ignore?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: asosiy omil nima? Ikki: ma’lumot nechta shahardan? Uch: muallif nimani e’tiborsiz qoldiradi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: uy-joy xarajatlari, ya’ni housing costs. Ikkinchi: qirqta shahar, forty cities. Uchinchi: qishloq sektori, the rural sector. Birinchisini noto‘g‘ri aytgan bo‘lsangiz, “major factor” iborasini eslang: asosiy omil. Yana e’tibor bering: talaba tanqidni “I think” bilan yumshoq ifodaladi va “True, but” bilan e’tirozga o‘tdi.
scenes.say: Housing costs. Forty cities. The rural sector. Notice how politely the speakers disagree: true, but only the largest.
scenes.say_uz: Uy-joy xarajatlari. Qirqta shahar. Qishloq sektori. Suhbatdoshlar qanday xushmuomalalik bilan e’tiroz bildirishiga e’tibor bering.

scenes.title: Uchinchi nuqta: rasmiy sinonimlar
scenes.say_native: Uchinchi nuqta: oddiy so‘zlarning rasmiy sinonimlari. Get o‘rniga obtain, buy o‘rniga purchase, help o‘rniga assist, need o‘rniga require, enough o‘rniga sufficient. Rasmiy so‘zlar ko‘pincha lotin ildizli, uzunroq va yozma uslubga xos. Suhbatda “get” va “help” mutlaqo normal. Maqsad oddiy so‘zlarni tashlab yuborish emas, matnning uslubiga mos tanlash. O‘zbekchada ham “olmoq” bilan “qo‘lga kiritmoq” orasida shunday farq bor.
scenes.say: Informal words often have formal partners: get and obtain, buy and purchase, help and assist, need and require, enough and sufficient. Choose by the style of the text.
scenes.say_uz: Oddiy so‘zlarning rasmiy hamrohlari bor: get va obtain, buy va purchase, help va assist, need va require, enough va sufficient. Matn uslubiga qarab tanlang.

scenes.title: Gaplarda taqqoslash

examples.t: The team obtained sufficient funding.
The study demonstrates a clear link.
Approximately half of the sample agreed.

scenes.say_native: Yana bir nechta juftlik. Start o‘rniga begin yoki commence, commence haddan tashqari rasmiy, ko‘proq shartnomalarda uchraydi. End o‘rniga conclude. Show o‘rniga demonstrate. Son bilan about o‘rniga approximately. Big o‘rniga substantial yoki considerable. Eslab qoling: tanlanma bu sample, ya’ni so‘rovda ishtirok etganlar guruhi. Gaplarni tinglang.
scenes.say: The team obtained sufficient funding. The study demonstrates a clear link. Approximately half of the sample agreed. The meeting concluded at noon.
scenes.say_uz: Jamoa yetarli mablag‘ni qo‘lga kiritdi. Tadqiqot aniq bog‘liqlikni ko‘rsatadi. Tanlanmaning taxminan yarmi rozi bo‘ldi. Yig‘ilish tushda yakunlandi.

scenes.title: Frazal fe’l va bitta fe’l

examples.t: The committee will investigate the complaint.

scenes.say_native: Akademik uslubda frazal fe’llar ko‘pincha bitta fe’l bilan almashtiriladi. Look into bu investigate, find out bu establish yoki ascertain, carry out bu conduct, come up with bu devise yoki propose, deal with bu address, go up bu increase, put up with bu tolerate. Frazal fe’llar noto‘g‘ri emas, lekin yozma ilmiy matnda bir so‘zli fe’l jiddiyroq eshitiladi. Ma’ruzada frazal fe’llar ham o‘z o‘rnida.
scenes.say: The committee will investigate the complaint. Researchers devised a new method. Instead of look into, find out and deal with, academic writing prefers investigate, establish and address.
scenes.say_uz: Qo‘mita shikoyatni tekshiradi. Tadqiqotchilar yangi usul ishlab chiqishdi. Ilmiy yozuv look into o‘rniga investigate, find out o‘rniga establish, deal with o‘rniga address ni afzal ko‘radi.

scenes.title: Rasmiy so‘zni noto‘g‘ri qo‘llash
board: ✗ I utilise my phone every day.
✓ I use my phone every day.
scenes.say_native: Rasmiy so‘z har doim ham mos kelmaydi. Birinchi xato: assist odamga yordam berish ma’nosida, muammoga emas. “The law assisted the problem” emas, “addressed”. Ikkinchi xato: utilise kundalik gapda g‘alati eshitiladi va ko‘pincha oddiy use eng yaxshi tanlov. Lug‘atdan sinonimni ko‘r-ko‘rona olmang, avval misol gapga qarang.
scenes.say: The law addressed the problem; assist is for people. Use is usually better than utilise. Never choose a formal synonym without checking an example sentence.
scenes.say_uz: Qonun muammoni hal qildi; assist odamlarga nisbatan. Use ko‘pincha utilise dan yaxshi. Misol gapni tekshirmasdan rasmiy sinonim tanlamang.

scenes.title: Rasmiylashtiring
board: 3) The study shows a big rise.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gap. Har birini akademik uslubda qayta ayting. Quyidagi so‘zlarni rasmiy sinonimlari bilan almashtiring: got, needs, shows, big va looked into. Yuqoridagi juftliklarni eslang, lekin hamrohlikni ham tekshiring: “substantial” bilan qaysi ot yaxshi keladi? Har bir gapni baland ovozda, to‘liq ayting.
scenes.say: One: we got enough money. Two: the firm needs more staff. Three: the study shows a big rise. Four: experts looked into the case. Rewrite each one formally.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: pulimiz yetarli bo‘ldi. Ikki: firmaga ko‘proq xodim kerak. Uch: tadqiqot katta o‘sishni ko‘rsatadi. To‘rt: mutaxassislar ishni o‘rgandi. Har birini rasmiy qayta ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3) The study demonstrates a substantial increase.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bir: we obtained sufficient funding. Ikki: the firm requires additional staff, additional bu more ning rasmiy shakli. Uch: the study demonstrates a substantial increase, rise ham mumkin. To‘rt: experts investigated the case. Sizning javobingiz biroz boshqacha bo‘lsa ham xavotir olmang: indicates, considerable, examined ham to‘g‘ri bo‘ladi. Muhimi, uslub bir xil bo‘lishi va hamrohlik to‘g‘ri bo‘lishi.
scenes.say: We obtained sufficient funding. The firm requires additional staff. The study demonstrates a substantial increase. Experts investigated the case.
scenes.say_uz: Biz yetarli mablag‘ni qo‘lga kiritdik. Firmaga qo‘shimcha xodim kerak. Tadqiqot sezilarli o‘sishni ko‘rsatadi. Mutaxassislar ishni tekshirdi.

scenes.title: Aldamchi do‘stlar

examples.t: The actual cost was higher.
Eventually, the team agreed.

scenes.say_native: Ba’zi so‘zlar o‘zbek yoki rus tilidagi o‘xshashiga aldaydi. Actual bu “aktual” emas, ya’ni dolzarb degani emas. U haqiqiy, real. Dolzarb uchun current yoki topical. Eventually bu “ehtimol” emas, oxir-oqibat. Control ko‘pincha boshqarmoq, ichida nazorat qilish ma’nosi ham bor, lekin tekshirmoq emas: tekshirmoq check. Argument akademik kontekstda janjal emas, asoslangan fikr. Bu oxirgisi juda muhim.
scenes.say: The actual cost was higher; actual means real, not current. Eventually, the team agreed; eventually means in the end. In academic writing an argument is a reasoned case, not a quarrel.
scenes.say_uz: Haqiqiy xarajat yuqoriroq edi; actual real degani, dolzarb emas. Oxir-oqibat jamoa rozi bo‘ldi. Akademik yozuvda argument janjal emas, asoslangan fikr.

scenes.title: To‘rtinchi nuqta: yozuvda qo‘llash
board: A growing body of evidence suggests that…
scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi nuqta: so‘zlarni yozuvda ishlatish. Yakka so‘z yodlash yetarli emas, ularni tayyor qoliplarga joylashtirish kerak. A growing body of evidence suggests that, dalillar shuni ko‘rsatmoqda. This has significant implications for, bu uchun sezilarli oqibatlari bor. Several factors contribute to, bir qancha omillar hissa qo‘shadi. The findings are consistent with, topilmalar bilan mos keladi. Har bir qolipga o‘zingizning mavzuingizdan gap tuzing.
scenes.say: A growing body of evidence suggests that sleep affects memory. This has significant implications for schools. Several factors contribute to the effect.
scenes.say_uz: Tobora ko‘payayotgan dalillar uyqu xotiraga ta’sir qilishini ko‘rsatmoqda. Bu maktablar uchun sezilarli oqibatlarga ega. Bir qancha omillar ta’sirga hissa qo‘shadi.

scenes.title: Namuna paragraf
board: Academic words: evidence · factor · impact · establish · significant · policy
scenes.say_native: Endi to‘liq namuna paragrafni tinglang. Mavzu: maktab darslarining boshlanish vaqti. Paragrafda fikr tartibi bor: bosh gap, dalil, tahlil va xulosa. Tinglab, qaysi so‘zlar bugungi darsdagi oilalarga va hamrohliklarga tegishli ekanini ushlashga harakat qiling. Keyingi sahnada paragrafni birgalikda tahlil qilamiz.
scenes.say: A growing body of evidence suggests that later school start times improve teenagers' concentration. Researchers have established that sleep is a key factor in learning. Although the impact varies between schools, the improvement is statistically significant. Policy makers should therefore consider this evidence carefully.
scenes.say_uz: Tobora ko‘payayotgan dalillar maktabdagi kechroq boshlanish vaqti o‘smirlarning diqqatini yaxshilashini ko‘rsatadi. Tadqiqotchilar uyqu o‘qishda asosiy omil ekanini aniqlashdi. Ta’sir maktablarga qarab farq qilsa ham, yaxshilanish statistik jihatdan ahamiyatli. Shuning uchun siyosatchilar bu dalilni diqqat bilan ko‘rib chiqishi kerak.

scenes.title: Paragrafni tahlil qilamiz
scenes.say_native: Paragrafni tahlil qilaylik. Birinchi gap qoliplar bilan boshlandi: a growing body of evidence. Ikkinchida established va key factor. Uchinchida vary fe’li, impact ot va significant sifat birgalikda keldi. To‘rtinchisi xulosa: should therefore consider. “Therefore” mantiqiy bog‘lovchi. Diqqat qiling: hech bir gapda “big”, “get”, “show” yo‘q, shunga qaramay, til tabiiy.
scenes.say: Notice the pattern: a framing phrase, then evidence, then a cautious conclusion with therefore. There is no big, get or show anywhere, yet the language is natural.
scenes.say_uz: Qolipga e’tibor bering: kirish ibora, keyin dalil, so‘ng ehtiyotkor xulosa. Bu yerda big, get, show yo‘q, shunday bo‘lsa-da til tabiiy.

scenes.title: Tinglash: tahrir suhbati
board: A: 'The firm got a lot of money.' Too casual.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi suhbat. Ikki hamkasb hisobotni tahrir qilmoqda va norasmiy iboralarni almashtirmoqda. Tinglang: ular qaysi so‘zlarni qanday almashtiradi va nega. Bu real ishxona vaziyati, chunki tahrir qilish yozuvning muhim qismi: birinchi qoralama kamdan-kam hollarda rasmiy chiqadi.
scenes.say: This sentence says the firm got a lot of money from investors. It sounds too casual for a report. How about: the firm obtained substantial funding from investors? Better. And the plan went wrong? Let's write: the strategy proved unsuccessful.
scenes.say_uz: Bu gapda firma investorlardan ko‘p pul oldi deyilgan. Hisobot uchun juda oddiy. Unda: firma investorlardan sezilarli mablag‘ jalb qildi desak-chi? Yaxshiroq. Reja amalga oshmadi-chi? Strategiya muvaffaqiyatsiz bo‘lib chiqdi deb yozamiz.

scenes.title: Savollar
scenes.say_native: Uchta savol. Birinchi: got o‘rniga qaysi so‘z qo‘yildi? Ikkinchi: a lot of money o‘rniga qaysi ibora tanlandi? Uchinchi: went wrong o‘rniga nima yozildi? Suhbatni eslang va har bir javobni to‘liq ibora bilan ayting. Agar eslolmasangiz, hozirgi darsdagi rasmiy sinonimlar ro‘yxatiga qarang.
scenes.say: One: what replaces got? Two: what replaces a lot of money? Three: what replaces went wrong?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: got o‘rniga nima? Ikki: a lot of money o‘rniga nima? Uch: went wrong o‘rniga nima?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Got o‘rniga obtained. A lot of money o‘rniga substantial funding, funding bu moliyalashtirish yoki mablag‘ va u ham sanalmaydigan ot. Went wrong o‘rniga proved unsuccessful. Prove bu yerda “bo‘lib chiqmoq” ma’nosida kelgan. “Proved effective”, “proved difficult” akademik matnda ko‘p uchraydi.
scenes.say: Obtained. Substantial funding. Proved unsuccessful. The verb prove can mean turn out to be: proved effective, proved difficult.
scenes.say_uz: Obtained. Substantial funding. Proved unsuccessful. Prove “bo‘lib chiqdi” ma’nosida ham keladi: proved effective, proved difficult.

scenes.title: Uch yuz so‘zni qanday o‘rganish
scenes.say_native: Uch yuz so‘z, bu har kuni besh so‘z bilan atigi oltmish kun. Tizim shunday. Birinchi: so‘zni oilasi bilan oling, ya’ni ot, fe’l, sifat. Ikkinchi: ikki uch hamrohini yozing. Uchinchi: o‘zingizning hayotingizdan bitta gap tuzing, tayyor misolni ko‘chirmang. To‘rtinchi: takrorlashni oraliq bilan qiling: ertasi kuni, uchinchi kuni, bir haftadan keyin.
scenes.say: Five words a day gives three hundred words in sixty days. Learn the whole family, note two or three collaborators, write one sentence of your own, and review after one day, three days and a week.
scenes.say_uz: Kuniga besh so‘z oltmish kunda uch yuz so‘z beradi. Butun oilani o‘rganing, hamrohlarini yozing, o‘z gapingizni tuzing va bir, uch, yetti kundan keyin takrorlang.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq
board: The government looked into the problem and found out that many people got help. The results show a big change.
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Ekrandagi ikki gapni akademik uslubda qayta yozing yoki baland ovozda ayting. Almashtiring: looked into, found out, got help, show, big change. Bu darsda o‘rganganlaringizdan foydalaning, imkon qadar kollokatsiyaga ham e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Rewrite formally: the government looked into the problem and found out that many people got help. The results show a big change.
scenes.say_uz: Rasmiy uslubda qayta yozing: hukumat muammoni o‘rgandi va ko‘p odam yordam olganini aniqladi. Natijalar katta o‘zgarishni ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Namunaviy javob
board: The government investigated the issue and established that many people received assistance.
The results demonstrate a significant change.
scenes.say_native: Namunaviy javob: the government investigated the issue and established that many people received assistance. The results demonstrate a significant change. Look into o‘rniga investigate, find out o‘rniga establish, got help o‘rniga received assistance, show o‘rniga demonstrate, big o‘rniga significant. Examined, ascertained, substantial ham to‘g‘ri bo‘lardi.
scenes.say: The government investigated the issue and established that many people received assistance. The results demonstrate a significant change.
scenes.say_uz: Hukumat masalani tekshirdi va ko‘p odam yordam olganini aniqladi. Natijalar sezilarli o‘zgarishni ko‘rsatadi.

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
board: 1) Word families: ot · fe’l · sifat · ravish
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Birinchi: so‘z oilalari, va qo‘shimchalar turkumni ko‘rsatadi. Ikkinchi: kollokatsiyalar, conduct research, draw a conclusion, significant impact. Uchinchi: oddiy so‘zlarning rasmiy sinonimlari, lekin ularni o‘rinli tanlash kerak. To‘rtinchi: yozuvda tayyor qoliplar. Uch yuz so‘zlik tizim: kuniga besh so‘z va oraliqli takrorlash. Siz endi so‘zni emas, so‘zlar tarmog‘ini o‘rganyapsiz.
scenes.say: Let us review. Word families, collocations, formal synonyms and writing frames. Learn networks of words, not single words, and review them at spaced intervals.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa: so‘z oilalari, kollokatsiyalar, rasmiy sinonimlar va yozuv qoliplari. So‘zlarni yakka emas, tarmoq sifatida o‘rganing va oraliq bilan takrorlang.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Write a paragraph (6–8 sentences) using 15 academic words
Underline them; check part of speech and collocation
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa. O‘zingiz tanlagan mavzuda oltidan sakkiztagacha gapdan iborat paragraf yozing va unda o‘n beshta akademik so‘zdan foydalaning. So‘zlarning tagiga chizing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: har bir so‘zning turkumi gapda to‘g‘ri, kamida beshtasi to‘g‘ri hamrohi bilan kelgan va hech bir joyda “make research” kabi xato yo‘q. Keyingi darsda sinonimlar orasidagi nozik farqlarni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Write a paragraph of six to eight sentences using fifteen academic words. Underline them and check each part of speech and collocation. See you next time.
scenes.say_uz: Oltidan sakkiztagacha gapli paragraf yozing va unda 15 ta akademik so‘z ishlating. Ularning tagiga chizing, turkum va hamrohlikni tekshiring. Keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz.

homework_uz: O‘zingiz tanlagan mavzuda 6–8 gapdan iborat paragraf yozing va unda 15 ta akademik so‘zdan foydalaning. So‘zlarning tagiga chizing. Mezon: har bir so‘z to‘g‘ri turkumda, kamida beshtasi to‘g‘ri kollokatsiyada, tipik xatolar yo‘q.

quiz.why_uz: Ot oldida sifat kerak: economic growth. Economical tejamkor degani.
Research bilan conduct yoki carry out ishlatiladi.
Evidence sanalmaydi: a great deal of evidence, evidences emas.

quiz.q: Choose the formal equivalent of 'find out' in a report.
quiz.why_uz: Find out ning rasmiy shakli establish yoki ascertain.
Ot oldida sifat kerak: consistent results.

quiz.q: Which word has stress on the second syllable?
quiz.why_uz: Analysis da urg‘u ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda: aNAlysis.
Actual haqiqiy degani. Dolzarb uchun current yoki topical.

options: The law helped up the problem.
quiz.why_uz: Address a problem to‘g‘ri kollokatsiya; assist muammoga emas, odamga yordam.

quiz.q: Choose the best collocation: 'It is ___ accepted that exercise is healthy.'
